mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the breathing lungs to circulation was most worthwhile: the result tied gas exchange, hemoglobin and delivery to tissues into one route.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the pleural membranes was fairly predictable from their labeled lung and chest sides, though the explanation helped clarify their role.

surprise.text: I expected to add capillaries directly to the lined sacs, but the airways had to be connected first. The compatibility feedback made the required next step clear.

arbitrary.text: The required order of adding airways before capillaries felt somewhat arbitrary; the pictures explained where both belonged but did not make that order obvious.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested to see how the oxygen-delivering circulation connects with the guided arm and its working muscles. The pressure and exchange illustrations made the connections understandable from their descriptions, though the finished images have not been tested.
